title: andryala aurea
intro: Andryala aurea, commonly known as Golden Andryala, is a perennial plant species belonging to the family Asteraceae. It is traditionally used for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it effective in treating various conditions such as wounds, skin issues, and gastrointestinal problems. The therapeutic actions of Andryala aurea include antimicrobial, antiviral, and antifungal activities, as well as its potential to reduce pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
